theorem: Each positive two-state filter matrix has cross ratio 36; row or column emission scaling cancels from that ratio. Birkhoff's formula therefore gives the exact uniform Hilbert-projective contraction coefficient (sqrt(36)-1)/(sqrt(36)+1)=5/7. This supplies the contraction ingredient absent in ST300. A separate weighted derivative-recursion estimate is still required before promoting the finite-depth Chernoff optimizer.
